_scope: Aqueous carbonyl hydration constants Khyd = [gem-diol]/[carbonyl] at 298 K for species in the 367-reaction set. The stored ModelSEED microspecies is the free carbonyl; the effective transformed formation energy of the equilibrium mixture is lower by -RT ln(1 + Khyd). Only species with a defensible literature Khyd are listed; all others are treated as unhydrated (the current pipeline behaviour). conf = confidence in the value.
